phaseName: Phase 2: Core Features — Memory, Goal, Todo
goal: Add Drizzle/SQLite persistent memory, /goal background daemon, and native todo CLI
summary: Phase 2 complete. 3 new packages created: (1) nyan-memory — Drizzle/SQLite schema with sessions/messages/goals/todos tables + CRUD store, (2) nyan-goal — GoalDaemon with plan→execute→reflect cycle + CLI with start/list/create, (3) nyan-todo — todo CLI with add/list/done/depends. All packages use @nyan-works/nyan-* naming and export clean entry points.
